title: Sekiro: No Defeat Anime's Theatrical Version Screens in Japan for 3 Weeks Starting on September 4
content: The staff for Sekiro: No Defeat , the new anime based on FromSoftware 's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice game, revealed on Friday the anime's theatrical edition will screen in theaters in Japan for three weeks starting on September 4. The staff also revealed the main visual for the theatrical version.
author: ANN

title: 'Vertex Force' Reveals Additional Staff, Second Teaser Promo, Fall 2026 Premiere
content: The official website for the Vertex Force original television anime revealed the additional staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and the second teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sekiro: No Defeat Reveals Main Visual, Details on Theatrical Release in Japan
content: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT anime revealed the main visual, along with details on the theatrical release in Japan. It will premiere on Friday, September 4, 2026, with a limited three-week run in cinemas nationwide. The anime is coming exclusively to Crunchyroll in 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Resident Evil Requiem Game's Update Adds Postgame 'Leon Must Die Forever' Mode
content: CAPCOM released a free update on Friday for its Resident Evil requiem ( Biohazard requiem ) game adding a new "Leon Must Die Forever" postgame mode. CAPCOM posted a video revealing the new mode. "Leon Must Die Forever" is available only after finishing the game's main story mode.
author: ANN

title: Nintendo Raises Switch 2 Console Prices in Japan, U.S., Canada, Europe
content: The changes will take effect on May 25 in Japan and on September 1 in the U.S., Canada, and Europe. In the U.S. the price will rise from US$449.99 to US$499.99. In Canada the price will rise from CAD$629.99 to CAD$679.99. In Europe the price on the My Nintendo Store will rise from €469.99 to €499.99.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Debuts English Dub for Tamon's B-Side Anime

title: Hiro Mashima's Dead Rock Manga Goes on Hiatus, Returns With New Arc This Winter
content: The June issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine published the final chapter of the "Academy Arc" for Hiro Mashima 's DEAD ROCK manga on Thursday. The manga will go on hiatus before returning with a new "Godfall" arc this winter.
author: ANN

title: Tokyo 7th Sisters Idol Raising Smartphone Game Ends Service After 12 Years
content: The official website for Donuts ' Tokyo 7th Sisters idol raising smartphone game announced on Thursday that the game will end service on August 12, 12 years after it launched in February 2014. The game's main story will end with the story for the "Stella MiNE" group in the game's current "Episode 2053" story arc.
author: ANN

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' TV Anime Adaptation Airs in 2026
content: WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula label announced a television anime adaptation of Shaoh 's Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) web manga on Friday, revealing a commemorative illustration drawn by the original creator (pictured). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: I'm Dating a Dark Summoner! Short Anime Airs on TV This Year
content: The staff for the short anime of Shaoh 's I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ! ( Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ) manga announced on Friday that the anime will be on television, and will premiere this year. Shaoh provided a new illustration (seen below) to celebrate the anime.
author: ANN
